title: Juicy Roasted Jamaican Baby Aubergine Roast
description: A fermented, crisp, and flavorful Jamaican dish featuring roasted baby aubergine, perfect for a sick day, and paleo-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, blend the scotch bonnet pepper, onion, garlic, thyme, allspice, salt, and black pepper to make a spice paste.
Place the baby aubergine in a bowl and toss with the spice paste until they are evenly coated.
Heat the coconut oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the baby aubergine to the skillet and sear until they are browned on all sides.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the baby aubergine rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the roasted baby aubergine hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
